=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2511-2571 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` reads the marker (`_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen`) and later writes the retry/hold comment, but these steps are not serialised per PR head, and `_merge_lease_gate` renews a lease the same PR already holds, so two concurrent callers for one PR can both see "no marker" and both post a comment.
  WHY: Concurrent review/poller/sweep calls can post duplicate retry notes or `<!-- ai:final-ci-wiring-behind:v1 ... -->` hold comments, which breaks the documented "one comment, at most two attempts per head" budget. minimax, gpt-6-luna and glm rated this NIT; gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2514-2571 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` returns 2 (the login or comments read failed), the update is still attempted, and if it is refused, the check at line 2536 (`wiring_seen_rc -eq 1 || -eq 3`) skips both the retry note and the hold marker, so only `held update_branch_refused` is logged.
  WHY: While the read keeps failing, every tick takes the merge lease and makes one PUT plus one PR read, and nothing on the PR tells an operator the branch needs manual action. All four reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:186-190 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The e2e-smoke-test exit now holds a behind head with `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true` and dispatches no final CI. The final-CI sweep (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:303-340) does not filter candidates on the `e2e-smoke-test` label and calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci` without `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE`, so it can run `update-branch` on the e2e PR.
  WHY: If main's ci.yml gains a commit while an e2e PR is open, the next sweep tick pushes a merge commit onto the e2e branch mid-gate, which is the head change the opt-out exists to prevent. The agents fragment and the README say the same contradictory thing.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:131-139 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The auto-merge-off exit's `no_update_path` hold (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2506-2509) only writes a log line. In a consumer repo with `final_ci_workflow` set and ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false there is no sweep, so a behind head never gets a final CI or an update.
  WHY: The required `lint` / `ci/final` check never appears on the reviewed head, and nothing on the PR explains why. This conflicts with G2's "one clear reason on the PR and in the log".
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2536-2568 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: On a second refusal where `wiring_after_mergeable` is true, null, or unreadable, the hold-marker body still says "GitHub refused to update the branch from `%s` (for example, a merge conflict)", even though GitHub reported no conflict.
  WHY: The permanent hold comment sends the reviewer looking for a conflict that does not exist. `test_wiring_behind_second_refusal_after_retry_note_records_the_hold` (tests/test_review_final_ci.py:1232-1255) does not check the comment text.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2492 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "behind" decision uses the `compare` endpoint, which gemini says lists changes in both directions, so a PR that changes `ci.yml` itself is flagged as behind and forced to update.
  WHY: A PR that modifies `ci.yml` would be updated and get a new final CI dispatch it does not need, which violates G5. The reviewer stated no severity for this finding (its matching TASK_GAP is BLOCKER).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G5. A PR that itself changes `ci.yml` is not forced into an update by this rule alone: 'behind' means the base has commits to that file that the branch lacks, not that the two files differ."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`, the "behind" decision (lines 2470-2497, around line 2492 `grep -Fxq -- "${wiring_path}"`), plus tests/test_review_final_ci.py `test_pr_changing_ci_yml_itself_dispatches_as_today` (line 1178)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: the implementation relies on `compare`, which includes all changes in the `head...base` diff, and does not filter out PRs that already modified `ci.yml`; line 2492 consults only the base-side `wiring_paths` and never `repos/<repo>/pulls/<pr>/files`; the only G5 test sets `base_files` to `[{"filename": "scripts/x.sh"}]` (line 1179) and exits early at `not_behind`; no test covers the case where the base and the PR both changed `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- requirement: "G2. When the branch cannot be updated (conflict, lease held by another PR, update refused), the pipeline does not dispatch the final CI on the stale workflow. It records one clear reason on the PR and in the log, and the PR waits like any other PR that needs a branch update."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`, the `no_update_path` branch (lines 2506-2509) and the `merge_lease_<reason>` hold (lines 2520-2524)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: both hold branches only call `_pr_final_ci_wiring_log` (stdout) and post nothing on the PR; the lease hold relies on the merge-lease wait label; the `no_update_path` hold writes nothing on the PR at all
- requirement: "When the branch cannot be updated (conflict, lease held by another PR, update refused), the pipeline does not dispatch the final CI on the stale workflow. It records one clear reason on the PR and in the log."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`, refused-update handling
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: when `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` returns 2 (lines 2514-2515), the refused-update branch posts only for return codes 1 or 3 (line 2536), so it skips the PR comment and only logs the refusal (lines 2569-2570); `tests/test_review_final_ci.py::test_wiring_behind_unreadable_comments_attempt_without_posting` confirms this path
- requirement: "The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`; the final-CI sweep caller in scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: without the freshness side channel, the helper makes a `compare/<head>...<base>` request on every call (lines 2439-2441); the sweep calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci` once per candidate without supplying the side channel (scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh lines 317-341), so each sweep tick makes an extra compare request per candidate
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:186-190 (related: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2506-2509, scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:303-340) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The e2e-smoke-test exit now holds a behind head (`PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true`) and dispatches nothing. The sweep's candidate filter (lines 304-311) ignores labels, and line 340 calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci` without `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE`, so `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` runs `update-branch` on the e2e PR.
  WHY: If main's ci.yml changes while an e2e PR is open, the sweep pushes a merge commit onto the e2e branch mid-gate. The agents fragment and the README state the same contradiction. Suggested fixes (skip `e2e-smoke-test` candidates, or pass `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true` from the sweep) touch a file outside the plan grant.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:131-139 (with scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2506-2509) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `no_update_path` hold only logs. In a consumer repo with `final_ci_workflow` set and ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false, a behind head never gets a final CI or an update, and nothing on the PR explains why.
  WHY: The required `lint` / `ci/final` check never appears on the reviewed head, which violates G2's "one clear reason on the PR". A one-time note with reason=no_update_path would make `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` return 0, so the note needs a reason token that is not counted as a hold, or has to be posted without the marker.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2514-2519, 2536 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the login or comments read fails (rc=2), the update is still attempted, and a refusal posts no note or marker and is logged only as `held update_branch_refused`.
  WHY: Every call takes the merge lease and makes one PUT and one PR read with nothing recorded on the PR. The cost is bounded by tick frequency, so this is a NIT.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "G2. When the branch cannot be updated (conflict, lease held by another PR, update refused), the pipeline does not dispatch the final CI on the stale workflow. It records one clear reason on the PR and in the log, and the PR waits like any other PR that needs a branch update."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`, the `no_update_path` branch (lines 2506-2509) and the `merge_lease_<reason>` hold (lines 2520-2524).
  Evidence of absence: both hold branches only call `_pr_final_ci_wiring_log` and post nothing on the PR; the `no_update_path` hold writes nothing on the PR.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Not reported (3 related items): the G5 TASK_GAP (both base and PR edited ci.yml) is judged wrong, because an update is the specified behaviour; the hold marker after a second refusal is documented design; the same-PR concurrency race is dropped as speculative.
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh candidate jq lines 307-311, add `| select(((.labels // []) | index("e2e-smoke-test")) == null)` (1 line, outside the plan grant); scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `no_update_path` lines 2506-2509, post a one-time note with a reason token that is not counted as a hold, only when the comments read succeeded (8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2492 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "behind" check uses the `compare` endpoint, which shows changes in both directions, so a PR with its own `ci.yml` changes is wrongly flagged as behind and forced to update.
  WHY: A PR that modifies `ci.yml` is forced to update and gets a new final CI dispatch it does not need, which violates G5.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2514-2568 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The marker check and the retry/hold comment posting after a refused update are not atomic relative to the lease gate.
  WHY: Concurrent review and poller calls can both find no marker, both pass the lease gate for the same PR, and both post, which breaks the one-comment and at-most-two-attempts-per-head behaviour.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2514 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` returns 2, the code falls through to `_merge_lease_gate` but skips the check at line 2536, so it logs only `held update_branch_refused` with no hold marker and no retry note.
  WHY: When an update refusal coincides with a transient read failure, nothing on the PR tells the operator the branch needs manual action.
